paired_control: Best exact full-model parent from the same three HGS views and exact elite pools in each case-seed run.
gate: All nine paired units must be feasible and non-worsening. At least four of nine units must strictly improve, with at least one strict improvement in both PRD-75 and CY-150 strata.
no_rescue: Do not change architecture, cases, seeds, budgets, pool sizes, or pass rule.
Do not add another operator after H6.
Passing freezes the prototype for user review; it does not authorize full China81 or public V13 runs.
claim_boundary: Three cases by three seeds, with seed 1 previously seen in H5. This is directional robustness evidence, not formal China81 statistics.
